display_long_description:
Climb into the cab and learn the craft of parking a heavy truck and its semi-trailer — in VR, from the driver's seat.

Grab the multi-turn steering wheel with both hands and turn it hand over hand. Move the gear lever through a real shift pattern, with a live diagram on the dash. Reverse with nothing but your side mirrors: two main mirrors and two wide-angle mirrors, rendered in real time.

10 missions take you from the basics to a timed challenge:

Seat setup, engine start and a first stop
Full-lock steering and gear practice
A cone slalom without a trailer
Hitching the semi-trailer to the fifth wheel
A wide turn without cutting the corner
Straight-line backing, an offset bay and a 90-degree dock
A loaded route against the clock
Changing conditions. Every mission starts at a random time of day and in random weather, and the clock keeps moving: afternoon light turns into night, with headlights and a lit bay. Drive through clear skies, cloudy days, thick fog, rain, thunderstorms, snow and hail. Rain, storm, hail and snow reduce tire grip, so braking distances grow. You can also fix the time and weather in Settings.

Made for comfort. The game is played seated and you never move the camera yourself; the cab carries you. It includes comfort presets, a motion vignette, horizon stabilization, adjustable cabin motion and seat calibration.

Fully offline, single player, in English and Spanish.
